comparison.objective: Prime an insulin pen and set a 12-unit dose.
comparison.physical_skill: Remove a shield, orient the needle upward, dial, push against resistance, hold, and redial.
comparison.success_condition: A valid 2-unit safety shot with visible drop and five-second hold must precede a final 12-unit setting without needle contact or dropping.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is sequenced dose control and safe needle orientation, not precision rail transfer or continuous rolling-element containment.
